prose: Basis: the New York Times blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account. Alexandra Alter profiles Marissa Mayer - former Google VP, former Yahoo CEO - who has reinvented herself as a startup founder. Her company Dazzle, a team of about ten engineers, is building an AI assistant aimed at helping non-tech enthusiasts with mundane tasks, a fraction of the armies of programmers she once commanded and a deliberate bet on the consumer-AI mainstream.
